name: ListResourceGroups

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 资源组名称，用于模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The statuses of the resource groups to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询的资源组状态列表
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The types of the resource groups to query. **If this parameter is not specified, general-purpose resource groups are queried by default.**
parameters.help_zh: 查询的资源组类型列表，**为空默认查询通用资源组**
parameters.name: resource_group_types

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the resource group. Valid values include:

- `PrePaid`: subscription.

- `PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
资源组的付费类型。
- PrePaid：包年包月。
- PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: aliyun_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud tags
parameters.name: aliyun_resource_tags

parameters.help_en:
The sorting criterion for the results. The format is `FieldName SortOrder`. `SortOrder` can be `Asc` (ascending) or `Desc` (descending). If you do not specify `SortOrder`, the default is `Asc`. The following fields are supported:

- `Id`: Resource group ID

- `Name`: Resource group name

- `Remark`: Resource group remarks

- `Type`: Resource group type

- `Status`: Resource group status

- `Spec`: Resource group specifications

- `CreateUser`: The user who created the resource group

- `CreateTime`: The time when the resource group was created

Default value: `CreateTime Asc`
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段列表，支持定时时间、开始时间等字段。格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：

- Id  (Desc/Asc)：资源组ID
- Name  (Desc/Asc)：资源组名称
- Remark  (Desc/Asc)：资源组备注
- Type  (Desc/Asc)：资源组类型
- Status  (Desc/Asc)：资源组资源状态
- Spec  (Desc/Asc)：资源组规格
- CreateUser  (Desc/Asc)：创建人
- CreateTime  (Desc/Asc)：创建时间

默认值为CreateTime Asc
parameters.name: sort_by
